sourceFiles.pdf: SAGA EDITION - Force Unleashed Campaign Guide.pdf

process.discoveryMethod: Full DJVU searchable text keyword/type-line sweep and contents-section scan, across entire book rather than only vehicles chapter. Targeted independent CL/statblock headings for ground, air, wheeled, tracked, walkers and military vehicles.
reviewedSourceSections: Chapter VIII Prisoner Convoy printed p142
Chapter X Imperial Vehicles printed pp200-203
process.primaryPdf: Uploaded scanned source PDF independently SHA256 matched against prior 19-ship close-read ledger. Rendered and visually reviewed relevant original PDF pages and source statblock layouts for each new candidate. Prior published ship PDF checks inherited.
process.exhaustivenessLimit: Full TXT source search plus rendered candidate pages; does not claim every image-only PDF page visually scanned line by line.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: Armored Groundcar
sourceIdentityPolicies.reason: Printed 'Huge ground vehicle' does not explicitly say wheeled, but prose and surrounding Wheeled Vehicles section explicitly describe wheel-driven groundcar.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: Arrow-23 civilian model
sourceIdentityPolicies.reason: Only printed paramilitary version has a full CL 2 statblock; weaponless civilian version described narratively is not a separate publication claim.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: Flare-S vs Zephyr-G swoops
sourceIdentityPolicies.reason: Flare-S explicitly Large air vehicle (speeder); Zephyr-G explicitly Large ground vehicle (speeder).

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: Modified SoroSuub X-34 and Aratech 74-Z
sourceIdentityPolicies.reason: Two independent fully printed statblocks in Prisoner Convoy adventure, not covered by main vehicles chapter. The 74-Z repeats Core Rulebook name but is a distinct book/statblock publication claim.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: Speeder trucks in convoy
sourceIdentityPolicies.reason: Encounter says to use landspeeder statistics without a weapon for trucks; no independent new ship identity for unarmed trucks.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: A5 Juggernaut
sourceIdentityPolicies.reason: Printed type Colossal wheeled ground vehicle; should not be filed as walker or confused with A6 Juggernaut.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: AT-KT versus AT-CT
sourceIdentityPolicies.reason: Two separate walkers share AT-ST lineage but possess distinct printed statblocks.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: TX-130T
sourceIdentityPolicies.reason: Complete statblock starts on printed p203, despite the table of contents pointing at p202. Preserve this book's independent statblock even though a Clone Wars counterpart exists.

sourceIdentityPolicies.subject: Junk Droids, Dark Troopers, PROXY and other droid NPCs
sourceIdentityPolicies.reason: NPC/droid statblocks do not become vehicle statblocks absent an explicit vehicle-type line.
